row.scim_plan: Any package via Contact Sales (SSO features enabled)
row.sso_plan: Criteria Assess / Criteria Interview / Criteria Hire (all packages)
row.evidence: Criteria's Okta integration page says: 'Automatically create, update, and deactivate Criteria user accounts based on Okta directory changes using SCIM protocol.' Every package (Assess, Interview, Hire) is 'Request Pricing' only and includes 'Standard ATS integrations, SSO & MFA'.
row.notes: Quote-only: the three packages (Criteria Assess, Criteria Interview, Criteria Hire) have no public prices. All three include standard ATS integrations, SSO and MFA. SCIM is documented only on the Okta integration page, which needs a 'Criteria account with SSO features enabled' and a 2-4 week guided implementation with Criteria support. The Entra ID and OneLogin pages offer SAML SSO with JIT user creation only, so SCIM looks Okta-only (partial-like; the price gate takes precedence). Okta's own OIN entry ('Criteria HireSelect', last updated 2014) is SWA only, so Okta SCIM presumably runs through a custom app set up with Criteria. That is why idp.okta is via_generic, even though no public SCIM endpoint or attribute docs exist. The customer help centre (criteriacorp.zendesk.com) returns HTTP 403.

plans.name: Criteria Hire
plans.notes: Includes everything in Assess and Interview. Add-ons (AI upgrades, Criteria Develop, Premium Integrations) are also priced on request.

scim.plan: Any package via Contact Sales (account with SSO features enabled)
scim.notes: Documented only as a feature of the Okta integration, set up during a guided implementation. No public SCIM reference.

operations.notes: The Okta page says create, update and deactivate. Whether updates use PUT or PATCH is not stated.

limitations.text: SCIM is described only for Okta. The Entra ID and OneLogin integrations offer SSO with JIT user creation only.
Setup is a guided 2-4 week implementation with Criteria's Customer Support Team.

user_api.notes: Criteria advertises API-based ATS/HRIS integrations (c11), but no public API reference or user-management endpoints were found. api.criteriacorp.com returns an empty page.

okta.notes: The OIN 'Criteria HireSelect' app (last updated Apr. 22 2014) is SWA only. Criteria's own Okta page describes SAML SSO plus SCIM create/update/deactivate and JIT, configured with Criteria support (c4).

entra.notes: Criteria's page describes an enterprise SAML application with JIT provisioning, not SCIM. There is no Microsoft Learn tutorial; gallery listing not verified.

google.notes: Google Workspace is named as a compatible SAML 2.0 IdP.

onelogin.notes: From Criteria's own OneLogin page: SAML SSO with JIT user creation.

fallbacks.notes: JIT user creation is described for Okta, Entra ID and OneLogin SAML SSO. The help centre is not publicly reachable (HTTP 403), and no SCIM or API reference is public.
